stem: Problem 2.2 Suppose that the number of miles that a car can run before its battery wears out is exponentially distributed with an average value of 10 miles. If a person desires to take a 5-mile trip, what is the probability that he or she will be able to complete the trip without having to replace the car battery?

solution.reason: The mean is 10, so the exponential rate is λ=1/10. Thus P(X≥5)=e^{-λ·5}=e^{-1/2}.
